|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Nar Shaddaa (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-narshaddaa_ai91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/narshaddaa_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Coruscant (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Force drain +1 here. Once per game, if your control, may take Han's Toolkit into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Nar Shaddaa (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-narshaddaa_ai3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/narshaddaa_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/narshaddaa_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' the PC replaced its high-resolution PNG upload of the day before with the GIF made from it for Holotable (the PNG was moved to the “hires” folder); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (703×980 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Coruscant (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Force drain +1 here.
